question.value: Are there empirical relations among radio continuum, infrared and CO luminosities that can be used to estimate molecular gas mass and its cosmic evolution up to z = 1.5

we explore the evolution of the molecular gas mass function and the cosmological molecular gas mass density in six redshift bins up to $z = 1.5$.

Pairwise fit method and its treatment of upper limits and selection effects are not described
A sample of nearby galaxies (median z = 0.017) is extrapolated to z = 1.5 without direct validation of redshift evolution
Constant alpha_CO may bias the density at high z where starbursts are more common
